name: Sovereign Pace
description: Set an ally's time to the user's own pace for the length of a long breath.

name: Elder Reach
description: Cast a lance aged by a thousand years of wear so that no guard stands before it.

name: Unhurried Ward
description: Move so slowly in the user's own time that no blow can find the body.

name: Mercy Pause
description: Hold open the short window after a fall for as long as a healer needs within its edge.

name: Pause Decree
description: Decree a pause on one foe so the qi and the body both stop where they stand.

name: Ageless Mend
description: Run the mending of a grave wound through the years the body would need in the space of a few breaths.

name: Beyond Beat
description: Pass through a barrier by stepping into the beat that lies between two moments.

name: Delay Law
description: Lay a law of delay on a cast art so it arrives long after its caster has stopped.

name: Moment Crown
description: School move: crown a wide ground with a slow span of time that holds every foe in it a beat behind.

name: Unspent Time
description: School move: share the time the caster has not spent with allies as a ward that also quickens them.

name: Patient Verdict
description: School move: wait in a stretched moment and strike once at the instant a seal can be set.

name: Wasting Age
description: Spend a long age of wear on a region in one breath to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Orphan Breath
description: Act through one breath that belongs to no moment while the world holds; the breath is taken from nowhere; a consequence event.

name: Elder Pace
description: Lend an ally the settled pace of an old master for a long breath.

name: Aged Lance
description: Cast a lance whose point has aged an age so that it goes through any guard.

name: Lengthened Ward
description: Hold a ward whose time is longer than the fight so that it never wears down.

name: Open Pause
description: Keep the window after a fall open wide enough for a healer to reach a fallen ally.

name: Held Command
description: Command a single foe to hold and seal the qi and the body in that one moment.

name: Eternal Mend
description: Give a grave wound the full course of a lifetime's mending in a handful of breaths.

name: Passed Beat
description: Step into a beat that has already passed and walk out through a barrier.

name: Ordained Delay
description: Ordain a delay on an incoming art until it is long past the moment it was aimed at.

name: Moment Throne
description: School move: sit a wide ground in a slowed span of time that rules every body that enters it.

name: Patient Ward
description: School move: lay a ward of unhurried time on allies that quickens their step.

name: Unhurried Verdict
description: School move: pass a slow judgement on one foe with a single blow that seals the qi.

name: Era Collapse
description: Collapse a whole era of wear onto a region in one breath to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Borrowed Breath
description: Find a breath never spent in the moment before a death one breath old and give it back; a consequence event.

name: Unmoved Age
description: Hold one living being outside the passing of time so nothing can age or harm it; a consequence event.
